name: Sarutobi Genin

entries.name: Never Ending Drive
entries.text: If chakra would fall to 0, you may convert HP to chakra at a rate of 2 HP per 1 CP. You may continue to cast and activate features while at 0 CP.

All Sarutobi adversaries gain access to an additional Nature Release and its related jutsu (see Specialist Jutsu Lists). They also gain bonus defensive jutsu depending on their releases: Blue Fire, Water Shield, Bedrock Skin, Blurring Wind, Lightning Repel.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4) slashing damage.

notes: The Sarutobi Elemental Specialization sidebar on p.26 applies to every Sarutobi block and is repeated on each.

name: Sarutobi Chunin

entries.name: Adept Elementalist
entries.text: Select one damage type. Increase damage dealt with that type by 1 die and gain resistance to it.

entries.name: Adaptive Elements
entries.text: Twice per encounter, when casting a nature Ninjutsu, you may change its damage type to match another elemental jutsu you know.

All Sarutobi adversaries gain access to an additional Nature Release and its related jutsu (see Specialist Jutsu Lists). They also gain bonus defensive jutsu depending on their releases: Blue Fire, Water Shield, Bedrock Skin, Blurring Wind, Lightning Repel.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 2 attacks. You may spend your bonus action to make a third.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

notes: The Sarutobi Elemental Specialization sidebar on p.26 applies to every Sarutobi block and is repeated on each.
